title: if your grandsons love Pokemon they will LOVE the Pokemon t-shirt subscription!
text: I have two grandsons, 6 and 7, and they both love Pokemon...I started in September 2022 and they each get a package in the mail and a new specially graphics every month!...I was going to stop it after Christmas but they get so excited to get them I couldn't stop it!...my daughter said the t-shirts are their favorite shirts to wear everywhere!
label: positive
